clear_day.brief: bright calm high-altitude daylight, expansive clean blue atmosphere, ivory toy-like cloud banks, and a few tiny distant floating cliff-islands at the far side edges
clear_day.palette: clear sky blue, soft ivory, pale atmospheric cyan, tiny touches of fresh green on distant islands

radiant_golden.brief: golden-hour warmth across an expansive high-altitude sky, luminous cloud rims, tiny distant floating cliff-islands, magical but not sunset-dark
radiant_golden.palette: honey gold, apricot, warm cream, clear blue

celebration_connected.brief: joyful shared-day sky with coral and rose light, buoyant cloud shapes and restrained festive colour on tiny distant floating islands
celebration_connected.palette: coral, rose, peach, cream, celebratory gold

garden_bloom.brief: fresh spring sky with verdant tiny floating garden-islands far at the side edges, soft flower colour accents and clear post-morning light
garden_bloom.palette: leaf green, mint, petal pink, butter cream, soft blue

autumn_hearth.brief: cozy late-afternoon high sky, amber foliage limited to tiny distant floating islands at the outer edges, hearth-like horizon glow and settled comforting air
autumn_hearth.palette: amber, russet, caramel, warm cream, muted blue

twilight_reflective.brief: quiet blue-hour sky, soft violet atmospheric distance, a few subtle luminous points and calm dreamlike depth around distant floating cliff silhouettes
twilight_reflective.palette: indigo, violet, moonlit blue, dusty rose, pearl

inspired_journey.brief: open airy high-altitude distance suggesting movement and possibility, long soft cloud bands, teal-cyan clarity and a loose trail of tiny faraway floating islands
inspired_journey.palette: cyan, teal, sky blue, pale jade, warm white

rain_overcast.brief: rain-heavy overcast high sky, layered slate cloud banks, softened distant floating cliff silhouettes and wet atmospheric depth without painted raindrops
rain_overcast.palette: slate blue, rainwater teal, cool gray, muted green

mist_cold.brief: pale high-altitude mist and cold quiet air, softly obscured distant floating cliff forms, pearl-gray cloud veil and subtle frosted light without visible falling snow
mist_cold.palette: pearl, pale blue, cool gray, desaturated sage

storm.brief: dramatic but friendly approaching storm in an expansive high sky, deep layered blue-gray clouds, tiny distant floating cliff silhouettes and a cool light break without lightning
storm.palette: deep navy, blue gray, steel, cool silver
